experiment_name: BR-1: big-run v1 - scaled digit-dense closed-form compile (192 probe items, H1..H8) + genius-RAM multi-token block speed/accuracy arms
parent: ncm_c1 (verdict: THEORY WORKS, SPEED NEUTRAL AT CURRENT FIRE RATE; big-run lever = more probe data + higher digit-token density, no protocol change)

model_frozen.note: file lost in sandbox recycle on 2026-11-24; re-downloaded and MUST re-verify SHA before any build (GATE-3).

change_log_vs_c1_frozen_in_advance: probe items 48 -> 384 (indices 3+17*k, k=0..383; superset of C1 probe, train pool only)

probe target style: digit-dense - per answer line, emit each <<expr=result>> calculator annotation as its own line 'expr=result', drop prose lines, keep '#### N' verbatim (deterministic regex transform)
eval exemplar style: same digit-dense transform applied to train items 0,1; instruction asks for short one-per-line calculations ending with '#### <answer>'
eval item set and indices UNCHANGED (30 items, indices 7+43*k); max_new 384 UNCHANGED; greedy fp32 threads=2 UNCHANGED

amendment_0_pre_build_disclosed.reason: digit-dense targets shorten per-item answer regions (~90 -> ~35 positions), so 192 items would under-run the frozen 12000-row gate; row count re-estimated before any build executed
amendment_0_pre_build_disclosed.change: probe items 192 -> 384; S1 budget redefined per-slice (each foreground slice <= 460 s, probe-part cache resume allowed and disclosed) instead of single-slice total

compile_protocol_frozen.rows: answer-region positions only; h_t = final layer hidden at position t (float32); targets = token ids t+1..t+8 (EOS appended so tail positions have targets)

token_universe_U_frozen.rule: digit tokens plus answer-boundary tokens; ids asserted at build

compile_protocol_frozen.heads: for each horizon k in {1..8}: one-vs-all ridge logistic per class (closed-form solve, no gradients); standardized features (mu/sd from probe rows) + unregularized bias; lambda grid {1,10,100} selected by probe-val accuracy on last 20% of rows (tie -> larger lambda); final refit on all valid rows; tau_k = 60th percentile of max-logit confidence on correct val rows
compile_protocol_frozen.determinism_gate: full recompile from cached probe rows must give max|dW|=0 and max|dB|=0 and identical lambda/tau

build_gates_frozen.GATE-0_gold_alignment: 30/30 eval indices: state golds == dataset '#### N'
build_gates_frozen.S1_build_budget: total incl. model load <= 460 s in a single foreground slice; probe-part cache resume allowed and must be disclosed in times json

arms.B_br: genius block + verify/reason pass (identical to C1 arm B rule, horizons 1..8): propose consecutive-confident block; verify against base-model greedy argmax chain with ONE extra forward; accept longest agreeing prefix + 1 bonus token; outputs MUST be token-identical to A_br
arms.C_br: genius blind fire, no verify (diagnostic only, expected to diverge)

eval_protocol_frozen.items: GSM8K test indices [7+43*k for k in 0..29] (same 30 as C1); strict = single extracted '#### N' == gold, abstention counts wrong
primary_metrics: S2 speed: tok_per_s per arm over completed items; ratio = tok_s(B_br)/tok_s(A_br)
S3 accuracy: strict_acc per arm; B_br vs A_br delta (must be 0.0pp by construction)

verdict_bands_frozen.speed: ratio >= 1.10 SUCCESS; 0.95 <= ratio < 1.10 MARGINAL; ratio < 0.95 FAIL
verdict_bands_frozen.accuracy: B_br strict_acc == A_br strict_acc AND >= 29/30 token-identical -> THEORY HOLDS AT SCALE; else FAIL
verdict_bands_frozen.fire_rate: fire_rate >= 0.15 -> lever CONFIRMED (vs C1 0.0529); 0.08 <= fr < 0.15 PARTIAL; fr < 0.08 lever REJECTED
verdict_bands_frozen.stability: A_br strict vs C1 arm-A strict (0.50) reported as intelligence-stability delta of the digit-dense format

hypotheses.H1_fire: digit-dense format + distribution-matched probe raises fire rate to >= 0.15 of steps
hypotheses.H2_speed: at fire_rate >= 0.15 with longer blocks (H1..H8), B_br/A_br >= 1.10 (C1: 0.988)
hypotheses.H3_accuracy: B_br stays token-identical to A_br (accuracy difference 0.0pp) while C_br drops (verify/reason step is necessary)
hypotheses.H4_stability: A_br strict within +/-10pp of C1 arm-A (0.50) - digit-dense format does not destabilize the base model

tracking.push_policy: prereg pushed to GitHub NSC-1 before eval arms start; results+times pushed after verdict; heads.npz binary stays sandbox-side with SHA recorded
